verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a keyboard-driven editor in a few places: typing `[[]]` and `(())` creates page and block references, and `/query` invokes a slash command. Embedded media appears only as an embedded PDF reader and website embeds on the whiteboard canvas. Hands-on reports undercut the 'fast' part, describing noticeable lag, slowdowns, poor performance on blocks of text, and a bullet-centric structure that makes long-form writing cumbersome. Missing for 10: any evidence of headings, callouts, tables or code-block formatting; documented in-editor media embedding beyond PDFs and whiteboard embeds; evidence of fast editing performance.
